newsitem.title: USA: Office Depot, Staples call off meetings.
newsitem.headline: Office Depot, Staples call off meetings.

text.p: Staples Inc and Office Depot Inc said Thursday they intend to adjourn their special shareholder meetings scheduled for March 7 until 0900 EST/1400 GMT on March 14.

The companies previously said they expected a rsponse from the Federal Trade Commission about their merger by March 13, but have called off their March 7 meetings because no response has been received.

Staples said it will hold its meeting on March 14 at the offices of Hale and Dorr, 60 State Street, Boston, MA. Office Depot will hold its meeting on March 14 at its corporate office, 2100 Old Germantown Road, Delray Beach, Fla.
The companies signed a definitive agreement last September to merge, pending regulatory and shareholder approval.
Staples, Inc. currently operates 577 office products superstores in over 100 markets across the US and in Canada. Office Depot currently operates 572 stores in North America.
